elements.description:
Evidence freshness as a band that decays with age, plus contested and superseded marks – a badge, or a margin
strip for a document's paragraphs.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: "badge" – the mark and the band in words; "strip" – one bar per paragraph down a document's margin

properties.name: observed
properties.description: When the evidence was observed or published: epoch ms, an ISO date string or a Date

properties.name: profile
properties.description: How fast it decays: "fast", "standard", "slow", "lasting", or your own band boundaries in days

properties.name: band
properties.description: The band, set outright – `observed` and the profile are then ignored

properties.name: contested
properties.description: Other evidence disputes it: a dashed ring round the mark and the word "Contested"

properties.name: superseded
properties.description: Something newer replaces it: the mark turns gray and the badge says "Superseded" first

properties.name: changed
properties.description: The source has changed since it was used (the app compares what was relied on with what is there now): a blue dot on the mark and the words "Changed since used"

properties.name: now
properties.description: The moment the age is counted to, in epoch ms – defaults to when the element connected

properties.name: compact
properties.description: Badge: only the mark, with its words in a tooltip and for screen readers

properties.name: hideAge
properties.description: Badge: leave out the age ("8 mo. ago")

properties.name: bandLabels
properties.description: The words for the bands – your own vocabulary in place of High, Good, Aging and Stale

properties.name: contestedLabel
properties.description: The word for a contested piece of evidence

properties.name: supersededLabel
properties.description: The word for a superseded piece of evidence

properties.name: changedLabel
properties.description: The words for a source that has changed since it was used

properties.name: changedNote
properties.default: "It has changed since you used it – check it still says what you relied on."
properties.description: What a changed source means and what to do – said after the band, and in the tooltip; empty leaves it out

properties.name: subjectLabel
properties.description: What screen readers call the evidence: "Aging evidence, observed 8 months ago"

properties.name: items
properties.description: Strip: one entry per paragraph, in document order

properties.name: for
properties.description: Strip: the id of the document whose paragraphs the bars line up with; unset stacks the bars on their own

properties.name: selector
properties.description: Strip: which children of the `for` document count as paragraphs (a selector, default every child element)

properties.name: stripLabel
properties.description: Strip: the name of the list of bars

properties.name: paragraphLabel
properties.description: Strip: what an item without a `label` is called, before its number

properties.name: currentBand
properties.description: The band as shown: `band`, else worked out from `observed`, the profile and `now`

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-locate
events.description: Strip: a segment was clicked, or Enter / Space was pressed on it; detail `{ index, item, target }` (ValidityLocateDetail) – the paragraph it stands for, when `for` names a document

functions.name: validityTime
functions.description: A moment as epoch ms; NaN when it can't be read

functions.name: validityBand
functions.signature: validityBand(observed: number, now: number, profile: ValidityProfileName | ValidityProfile): ValidityBand
functions.description: The band of evidence observed at `observed`, as of `now` (both epoch ms), under a decay profile

functions.name: validityAge
functions.signature: validityAge(ms: number, style: "short" | "long", locale?: string): void
functions.description: An age as words in the page's language: short ("8 mo. ago") for the badge, long ("8 months ago") for screen readers

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Strip: the id of the document whose paragraphs the bars line up with (the element's `for`)

props.name: onLocate
props.description: Strip: called when a bar is clicked or activated from the keyboard, with the paragraph it stands for

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
